alt: Four successive panels show finite-credit admission, the introduction of unlimited entitlement, a stale credit-sum model and a revised model. The stale model reduces an unlimited user to zero credits and rejects a thirty-eight-page upload. The revised model retains finite versus unlimited entitlement and records admission with the authorizing group and plan. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
